body.title: Implement DesignReviewDelegate and CodeReviewDelegate
body.summary: In src/daemon/task-progress/review-measurements.ts (or a sibling file) add the two delegates implementing TaskProgressDelegate. progress(task) reads ReviewWorkers.progressOf for the identity bound at registration, maps it with the t2 functions, ignores a publication older than the last accepted incarnation and sequence, keeps the last accepted measurement when a sample is rejected, and never throws. ownerActivity compares ReviewWorkers.identity(key) with the incarnation of the last accepted publication (and processState alive for code review) and returns the next owner sequence or null. Neither delegate exposes cancel, so controls stay empty.
acceptanceChecks: each delegate's progress never throws and keeps the last accepted measurement on a rejected sample
ownerActivity returns a fresh sequence only for the live incarnation (and alive process for code review), else null
neither delegate exposes cancel so controls stay empty
